title: Transitivity of Boolean implication
statement: Let $M$, $M'$, and $M''$ be Boolean-valued functions on the integers. If every integer at which $M$ is true is also one at which $M'$ is true, and every integer at which $M'$ is true is also one at which $M''$ is true, then every integer at which $M$ is true is one at which $M''$ is true.
hypotheses_covered: Three Boolean-valued functions on the integers
Every true value of the first function is true in the second
Every true value of the second function is true in the third
